I fixed the three CSS regressions in `site/css/styles.css`. Both the desktop and phone snapshots now match the approved baselines (2 of 2 pass). I didn't approve or change any baselines.

- **`.position-absolute`** was set to `position: relative`. That left the "Sale" badges in the normal flow instead of pinned to the top-right of the card. It is now `absolute`.
- **`.lead`** had `font-weight: 700`, which made the product description bold. It is now `300`.
- **`.mb-2`** was `0.25rem`. That tightened the spacing under the star rows and made the cards 4px shorter on desktop. It is now `0.5rem`.
